verdict.rationale: Mastra is self-hostable (Apache 2.0 licensed for self-host per pricing page, runs on any Node.js-compatible runtime including Bun/Deno/Cloudflare, no forced vendor runtime), giving strong deployment portability. However, community evidence flags licensing confusion (Elastic v2 restricting hosted/managed service use in some contexts) and the framework leans on batteries-included patterns (e.g., Hono routes) that may create soft dependencies, so full vendor-independence isn't unambiguously confirmed.
